budget_items.topic: Unitil interconnection upgrade cost for Borrego Solar 1.5MW array
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unitil's estimated cost to upgrade its system for a 1.5MW solar array was reported; Borrego then looked at a 1MW system.
budget_items.quote: the estimated cost to upgrade the unitil system for a 1.5mw solar array at $902,600.

budget_items.topic: Borrego Solar projected town tax on solar project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessor's office and Borrego were looking at a tax figure for the solar project.
budget_items.quote: they are looking at a tax of $55,000.

budget_items.topic: EPG Solar personal property taxes to the town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: EPG said the project would pay personal property taxes of over $100,000 per year, a significant financial impact to the town.
budget_items.quote: they would be paying personal property taxes to the town which will have a significant impact to the town financially (over $100,000 per year).

budget_items.topic: Sewer fees and Sewer Commission self-funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 15% increase in sewer fees was reported; the Sewer Commission is meant to be self-funded and was using free cash without success.
budget_items.quote: there is a 15% increase in sewer fees and customers are concerned.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Budget Working Group said an override is needed because state funding has been cut and local revenues do not keep pace with inflation (passage of the printed text is garbled by OCR).
budget_items.quote: the state average for property tax bills and the override is needed because state funding has been cut significantly

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board discussed getting information to the public on the $2.2M override impact on the town.
budget_items.quote: regarding getting the information out to the public so that they can fully understand the $2.2m override impact on the town.
